title: Chinook helicopter flying over Greenwich in London
author: JoBrodie
processing: Recorded audio only. FFmpeg: mono, 32000 Hz, highpass 45 Hz, lowpass 5000 Hz. Extract 40–48.6 seconds. Crossfade final 0.6 seconds into first 0.6 seconds using smoothstep, keep 8 seconds, normalize peak to 0.82, PCM16 WAV.
